item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 16/Mar/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The warm and humid maritime airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong tomorrow. It will be gradually replaced by an easterly airstream later on Monday. A cold front will move across the coast of southern China on Tuesday. Temperatures will fall over the region. Under the influence of the associated dry continental airstream, the weather will be fine with cool mornings over the region midweek next week. A humid southerly airstream is expected to bring showers to the coast of Guangdong during next weekend.
